grade_rationale: 7 P1 findings; proxy-addr exploitable auth bypass + 69 unimplemented FRs (critical domain failure) satisfy F-grade criteria

specialists_skipped.name: chaos-monkey
specialists_skipped.reason: requires ALL services healthy; backend offline

escalations.title: proxy-addr — IPv4-Mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing (auth bypass)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker crafts X-Forwarded-For: ::ffff:127.0.0.1 to appear as localhost, bypassing IP-based access controls in Express middleware
escalations.recommendation: Update proxy-addr via npm update Express. Audit all IP-based access control paths. Test with TheGuardians red-team.

escalations.title: protobufjs — Arbitrary Code Execution via Malformed Messages
escalations.exploit_scenario: Send malformed .proto or .pb message to platform/orchestrator or portal/Backend — triggers RCE in protobufjs message parser
escalations.recommendation: npm install protobufjs@latest in platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend. Review what message sources are trusted vs. untrusted.

escalations.title: handlebars — JS Injection via AST Type Confusion (@partial-block)
escalations.exploit_scenario: Attacker tampers with the @partial-block AST node in a Handlebars template to inject and execute arbitrary JavaScript in the rendering context
escalations.recommendation: npm install handlebars@latest (>=4.7.8). Audit all Backend template rendering — if any templates accept user input, add strict escaping.

escalations.title: form-data — CRLF Injection in Multipart Field Names/Filenames
escalations.exploit_scenario:
Upload file with crafted filename 'evil.txt
X-Injected: header' to inject HTTP headers into multipart form data, potentially bypassing security checks
escalations.recommendation: Update form-data. Test all file upload endpoints with crafted CRLF filenames.

p1_findings.title: FR-WF-* IDs Invented — No Spec Backing for 13 Requirement IDs
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Traceability enforcer cannot validate any requirements — traceability system is entirely decorative. Any defect in the 30+ source files is undetectable via traceability gate.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add formal FR-WF-001 through FR-WF-013 IDs to Specifications/workflow-engine.md. This is a one-time spec edit that instantly validates all existing Verifies comments.

p1_findings.title: 69 Formal Requirements (FR-001–FR-069) Entirely Unimplemented
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: 69 active formal FRs (SQLite feature requests, dev cycles, pipeline orchestration) have zero implementation. Either major scope drift or stale spec misleads future agents into building wrong things.
p1_findings.recommendation: Immediately determine spec status: (a) archive dev-workflow-platform.md if superseded, or (b) create a Plans/ entry if it describes intended future work. Do not leave 69 live FRs silently unimplemented.

p1_findings.title: vitest — Arbitrary File Read/Execute via UI Server
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: If vitest UI server is accessible (e.g., dev server left running in staging), attacker can read arbitrary files from filesystem and execute code via HTTP request to UI endpoint
p1_findings.recommendation: npm install --save-dev vitest@latest in Source/Frontend and portal/Backend. Set ui: false in vitest.config.ts for non-development environments.

p1_findings.title: tinypool — Prototype Pollution RCE via Worker Options
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Malformed worker thread options passed to tinypool trigger prototype pollution leading to Remote Code Execution. Fixed as transitive dep when vitest is updated.
p1_findings.recommendation: Update vitest (tinypool is a transitive dependency — it updates automatically).

p1_findings.title: proxy-addr — IPv4-Mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing (Auth Bypass)
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker crafts X-Forwarded-For: ::ffff:127.0.0.1 header to appear as localhost, bypassing IP-based access controls in Express trusted-proxy middleware
p1_findings.recommendation: Run npm update in Source/Backend, platform/orchestrator, portal/Backend. Have TheGuardians test all IP-based access control paths.

p1_findings.title: protobufjs — Arbitrary Code Execution
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Send malformed .proto or .pb message to platform/orchestrator or portal/Backend — triggers arbitrary code execution in protobufjs message parser
p1_findings.recommendation: npm install protobufjs@latest. Classify all protobuf message sources as trusted/untrusted. Add validation layer for untrusted sources.

p1_findings.title: handlebars — JS Injection via AST Type Confusion
p1_findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker tampers with @partial-block AST node in Handlebars template to inject and execute JavaScript in server rendering context
p1_findings.recommendation: npm install handlebars@latest (>=4.7.8). Audit all Backend template rendering for user-controlled input.
